title: Anchor the test-directory glob so the sweep stops reading history dirs
action: The pg-4 goal-check judge raised one non-blocking advisory it proved by running the command: `fd -t d tests` in row 6 of the Provenance sweep matches any directory whose BASENAME contains 'tests', so it also returns docs/history/scripts-tests-move/ and docs/history/workflow-verb-tests/ — the sweep reads two history directories as test directories. In skills/bee-researching/references/trace-and-provenance.md, row 6 only, anchor the pattern so it matches a directory actually named tests. Change nothing else in the file. Then run the regen chain in order: bee dev render-skill-trees, then bee onboard --repo-root . --apply, then bee dev release-manifest --write.
verify: The anchored command run in this repo returns only directories named exactly tests, and returns real hits against a known behavior term. bee dev release-manifest --check is clean and the rendered copies match the source.

trace.outcome: The provenance sweep's test-directory glob is anchored, so it returns only directories named tests

report.outcome: The provenance sweep test-directory glob is anchored, so it returns only directories named tests
